notes: Initial read-only surface exposes battery voltage, current, and SOC from community ESPHome mappings at holding registers 0x7530-0x7532 (0.1 V / 0.1 A / %).
Detection uses plausibility anchors on raw battery voltage (400-700) and SOC (0-100).
Live confirmation against an Anenji GES48120M250-500P LCD/meter is still required before promoting beyond experimental.

known_limitations: Community map only; no manufacturer PDF committed yet.
knowledge_summary: Anenji GES48120M250-500P is a 48 V split-phase hybrid reported behind EyeBond/SmartValue collectors. Community ESPHome mappings for the Sumry/GES holding-register block at 0x7530 define battery voltage (x0.1 V), current (x0.1 A), and SOC. This experimental catalog entry binds a read-only modbus_catalog surface to that block so local detection can prefer it over unrelated SRNE/SMG probes once the anchors match.
